records.falsifier: Scheduled Span-F1 gain is below +0.05, File-F1 or valid completion degrades, any effect evidence lacks a receipt or range overlap, unknown usage appears, or treatment model tokens exceed control.
records.mechanism: At finalization, derive changed source ranges from the actual effect, select only delivered base observations overlapping those ranges, replace stale retained history with the bounded closure, and deterministically union its IDs into the validated final selection.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful continuity at completion under the fixed cumulative model input plus output token gate.
records.statement: Completion-time effect-evidence closure improves GLM-5.3-flash 8K ContextBench selection by retaining receipt-bound observations that overlap entities actually changed by the agent, without increasing cumulative model input plus output tokens.
